description: Public Service Commission - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 2004/49 of 01.02.2017 that notified the Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission in terms of Article 5 (1) of the Constitution
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Public Service Commission delegating powers related to granting concessions for Efficiency Bar Examinations to specific officers in the health sector. It deals with public service administration, specifically powers delegation and examination procedures, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel changes.
